results.title: oasdiff — API Change Review: approve breaking changes before production
results.snippet: Review and approve every API change on a hosted side-by-side page, no install. oasdiff posts it on every pull request with a breaking-change gate. Open-source CLI and GitHub Action; 755 changes detected. Supports OpenAPI 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2.

results.snippet: This allows us to audit the contract change proposed by our internal teams and easily see the history. In addition, a pull request for a configuration change triggers automated checks to ensure the validity of the routes and OpenAPI Specifications.

results.title: Handling breaking changes: automating semantic versioning for API SDKs (August 2026) | Fern
results.snippet: Fern's GitHub integration supports mode: release, mode: pull-request, and mode: push, and in pull-request mode it updates the existing bot-opened PR rather than opening a new one per regeneration, so the accumulated diff stays reviewable in one place. Publish to each registry, tag the commit, and record the version that each language shipped. That record is the baseline for the next run's diff, which closes the loop. Automated bumping only solves the arithmetic. The expensive part of a breaking change is the migration, and the tooling for that is separate.
